concept.title: Topic type classification
concept.abstract: This section explains how the Markdown-to-DITA converter classifies each heading-delimited section of a Markdown document into an appropriate DITA topic type. It describes the content patterns that the converter evaluates after each heading and the DITA body elements generated for the corresponding topic type.

conbody.p: Topic type classification is the process of determining the most appropriate DITA topic type for the content associated with a heading. Unlike DITA, Markdown does not explicitly identify content as conceptual, procedural, reference, or troubleshooting information. Instead, the converter analyzes the content that follows each heading and classifies the section according to its dominant content pattern.

Accurate topic classification ensures that the generated DITA topic uses the correct body element for its content. Each DITA topic type has a corresponding body element that supports a specific content structure. By selecting the appropriate topic type during conversion, the converter preserves the intended organization of the source content and generates DITA topics that follow the expected structural model.

The converter classifies each heading-delimited section based on the content that follows the heading. Descriptive paragraphs, procedural steps, reference information, and troubleshooting content are mapped to their corresponding DITA topic types and body elements.
